Lemma
[differentiating $\langle V,DV/dt\rangle $]

↗ lem:dc-ch9-2-covariant-pair-leibniz

1. ch9:2.10On each interval where $V$ is differentiable, \[ \frac{d}{dt}\Big\langle V,\frac{DV}{dt}\Big\rangle =\Big\langle \frac{DV}{dt},\frac{DV}{dt}\Big\rangle +\Big\langle V,\frac{D^2V}{dt^2}\Big\rangle , \] the identity used to pass from (5) to (6).
Proof

↗ lem:dc-ch9-2-covariant-pair-leibniz \sketch Apply the product rule section 1 to the pair $V$, with covariant derivative $\frac{DV}{dt}$, against the pair $\frac{DV}{dt}$, with covariant derivative $\frac{D^2V}{dt^2}$.

□
